title: The Amber Fleet
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Amsterdam, 1672. The Republic is at war, the fleets are burning, and navigator-cartographer Sanna de Vries has been given a commission no one wanted: chart the last uncharted sea — the Amber Route to the Baltic's secret harbors — with a crew of the navy's discards. The map she brings home will decide a war she was never meant to survive.
